target_node_context: Proposal accept-link generation path in Module 2.4 / Contract acceptance entry into Module 2.5
purpose: Generate a signed, expiring HMAC accept_token for proposal acceptance.

node.name: Security - Generate HMAC Accept Token
node.notes: Phase 3.0.1.1. Add this immediately before the proposal accept-link is assembled. Uses PROPOSAL_ACCEPT_HMAC_SECRET. The token format is lead_id.expiry_unix.signature.

implementation_notes: Do not replace the existing Module 2.5 workflow wholesale with this file; this is the smallest MAXSPLIT node patch.
3.0.1.2 will append accept_token to the proposal accept URL.
3.0.1.3–3.0.1.5 will parse, verify, check expiry, and branch invalid requests.
The current Module 2.5 accept endpoint is GET /webhook/proposal-accept and currently accepts a guessable lead_id; the master plan explicitly identifies this as a launch blocker.
test_cases: Valid lead ID + configured secret => token generated.
Generated token has three dot-separated parts: lead_id, expiry, signature.
Signature recomputed with the same secret matches the generated signature.
